name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Global 30m DEM)
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84 geographic), heights referenced to EGM2008
labels: Surface elevation (DSM, not bare-earth DTM). Includes buildings and vegetation.
license: Copernicus DEM — free for any use including commercial. Attribution required. See: https://spacedata.copernicus.eu/collections/copernicus-digital-elevation-model
provenance: Freely downloadable from AWS Open Data Registry (no registration required). Also available via OpenTopography.
limitations: 30m resolution insufficient for individual building height. DSM includes canopy and building surfaces — not bare-earth. Urban canyon and bridge artefacts possible. Vertical accuracy approx 4m RMSE globally. Use as coarse terrain reference only — not as ground truth for building heights.
intended_use: Task 3 (coarse terrain context for height estimation fallback), Task 2 (DEM processing pipeline testing)
